title: Private Culinary Walking Tour in Boston Historic Districts
includes: Food Samples; taste clam chowder, a fresh lobster roll, traditional thin-crust pizza, and a dessert.
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: This private culinary walking tour introduces Boston’s historic districts through authentic regional flavors. You begin in the Blackstone Block where narrow streets reflect early commercial life. Historic taverns and storefronts reveal the origins of local food traditions. At Boston Public Market, you enjoy included tastings that highlight New England specialties. Clam chowder and lobster roll reflect a long maritime heritage. Along the Greenway, modern design meets the path of former trade routes. In the North End, Italian influence shapes a rich culinary identity preserved across generations. At Paul Revere Mall, history connects with daily life in a meaningful setting. The experience concludes along the waterfront where Boston’s maritime past remains visible. Please note: The program and attractions may vary based on booking date/time and crowd conditions ensuring each visit is a unique experience.
